description: This file defines functions to generate dashboard data, charts, and number cards for asset management in an ERP system, including fetching fiscal year info, dashboard configurations, and chart/filter settings.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Main function to retrieve dashboard, charts, and number cards data based on current fiscal year.

methods.name: get_dashboards
methods.description: Returns dashboard configuration including charts and cards for assets.

methods.name: get_charts
methods.description: Generates chart configurations with filters and options for asset dashboards.

methods.name: get_number_cards
methods.description: Creates number card configurations for total assets, new assets, and asset value.
